meta.name: etetoolkit
meta.description: Analyze, manipulate, compare, annotate, and visualize phylogenetic or other hierarchical trees with ETE 4. Use for Newick/Nexus tree I/O, topology edits and pattern matching, Robinson-Foulds comparisons, gene-tree evolutionary events and reconciliation, NCBI/GTDB taxonomy, SmartView exploration, and publication rendering. Do not use it to infer trees from raw sequences; align sequences and infer a tree first.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 比较和可视化树状亲缘关系，生成科研论文级图表
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果研究物种演化，需要把树形关系整理成清晰的图。
copy.tagline_en: Compare and render phylogenetic trees for polished scientific figures.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you study evolution and often need visual comparisons for your papers.

howto.what: 装上后你可以让 Claude 读取、改写和比较系统发育树(Newick/NHX 等),检测基因复制与物种分化事件、标注 NCBI 分类信息,并输出 PNG/PDF/SVG 图片。
howto.when: 当你给出已建好的树文件(Newick/NHX 等)要读取、比较或绘图时触发;它不负责从原始序列推断树,需先比对建树。

say.text: 读取 tree.nw,统计叶子和节点数
say.note: 返回叶子数与节点总数

say.text: 把 tree.nw 做中点定根,另存为 rooted.nw
say.note: 生成重新定根的树文件

say.text: 给这棵树加 NCBI 分类注释并渲染成 PDF
say.note: 补充谱系信息并导出 PDF

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude can read, edit and compare phylogenetic trees (Newick/NHX), detect duplication and speciation events, annotate NCBI taxonomy, and render trees to PNG, PDF or SVG.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you hand it an already-built tree file for reading, comparison or drawing. It does not infer trees from raw sequences — align and build the tree first.

say_en.text: Read tree.nw and count its leaves and nodes
Midpoint-root tree.nw and save it as rooted.nw
Annotate this tree with NCBI taxonomy and render a PDF
